name: T-Mobile US
outlook:
What T-Mobile US says to expect

  • Full year 2026: Core Adjusted EBITDACore Adjusted EBITDA, which is Adjusted EBITDA less lease revenues, is expected to be between $37.35 billion and $37.45 billion, an increase at the midpoint from prior guidance of $37.1 billion to $37.5 billion.
  • Full year 2026: Adjusted Free Cash FlowAdjusted Free Cash Flow, including net payments for UScellular merger-related costs, is now expected to be between $18.7 billion and $18.8 billion, an increase at the midpoint from prior guidance of $18.4 billion to $18.8 billion.
  • Full year 2026: cash purchases of property and equipmentCash purchases of property and equipment, including capitalized interest, are expected to be approximately $10.0 billion.
  • Full year 2026: effective tax rateEffective tax rate is now expected to be between 24% and 25%, a decrease from prior guidance of between 25% and 26%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 28, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
